test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends are sitting around a round table facing the centre with equal distances between two neighbours. Wasim is second to the right of Muskan. Ekta is sitting to the immediate left of Rohit. Anushri is sitting third to the left of Wasim. Suresh is second to the left of Ekta. Who is to the immediate right of Wasim?
solution:
Given: Six friends are sitting around a round table facing the centre with equal distances between two neighbours.

1) Wasim is second to the right of Muskan.

2) Anushri is sitting third to the left of Wasim.
